newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 6,725 to dollar for Feb 13 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 6,725 to dollar for Feb 13 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate weaker at 6,725 to the dollar for February 13.
The reference rate set on Tuesday is a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Monday for February 12 is 6,464 to the dollar. It was 6,376 on Tuesday. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
